correctness.rationale: The normalized Hankel blocks are precisely beta covariances. For U=1-t, nU has gamma(s) moments with O(n^-1) error. Centered Taylor expansions have L² cubic remainders O(n^-3). The leading covariance trace is s||v||²/n² and exterior-square determinant is |Delta|²s²(s+1)/(2n^6). Taking both eigenvalue roots proves the two branches, followed by exact orthogonal Fourier counting and harmonic-series endpoints. The extracted checker passed 271 finite assertions; these do not replace the analytic argument.

value.rationale: The nonpolynomial C^3 result is a structural boundary-jet theorem, not a fixed-moment table. Two nearly collinear radial measurement channels have a universally dominant first-derivative n^-1 singular branch; their otherwise hidden second n^-2 branch is measured exactly by the antisymmetric second jet. The two sharp Schatten cutoffs and the exponential-symbol example give an operator-theoretic measure of redundant channel stability.
